I will now assemble the full evidence review from all four parts, beginning with required Web Search checks on provenance and any external claims.State. Pinned commit 6ed48cb1c4447d4f902d1fbc8a908a56185e34ed (StrangeTcy/epistemic-compiler). Read in full: WRITER_PAIR (both drafts verbatim), COMPLETE_EVIDENCE_PACKET (Table A 38 env rows, Table B 416 case rows, Table C 80 omission rows, Table D 340 matrix rows, Section E chart descriptions), COMPLETE_DIFFICULTY_MATRIX_CSV (340 rows with full difficulty_tuple keys), CAMPAIGN_PROVENANCE, EARLIER_ANALYSIS_OVERVIEW, INELIGIBLE_PASS_CSV_EXCERPT, and the 2026-10-29 supporting local check. Web Search accessed Inception Labs/OpenRouter/etc. pages confirming Mercury-2.5 existence and specs (no campaign data or public StrangeTcy/epistemic-compiler repo/commit retrieved; limitation noted, embedded sources used exclusively). Calculations performed: row sums (277 PASS/128 FAIL/405 scored/11 unscored; 17/7/12/2 env split; 172/68/165; omission 56+14+10; failure-label totals; 296/44/329/320/9/98 matrix; unweighted mean ≈69.2%; 214 vs 204+10 uniform; moco fractions and keys; guarantee 189/227; rejected/unscored disposition counts). Unverifiable/unread: actual SVG binary renders (descriptions only), exact dirty working-tree state, clean-source comparison, public origin of overview’s “10”, any external campaign data.

1. Draft gpt 6 luna max
Verdict: accept with corrections

Confirmed-arithmetic table (matches Tables A/B/C/D + local check):

QuantityValue
Selected / scored / unscored416 / 405 / 11
PASS / FAIL277 / 128
277/40568.4%
277/41666.6%
Env split (all-pass / zero-pass scored / mixed / unscored-only)17 (172) / 7 (68) / 12 (105/165 +1) / 2 (10)
Matrix rows / singleton / multi340 / 296 / 44
Rows with rate / endpoint / fractional329 / 320 / 9 (all moco)
Zero-pass tuples98 (19 env)
Unweighted mean / median (36 scored env)~69.2% / 8/9 = 88.9%
Failures (underfit / overfit_visible_tests / runtime consolidated / source_invalid / invalid_action / training_failed)51 / 49 / 11 / 9 / 5 / 3
Guarantees189 behavioral_reference / 227 compile_only
Omissions80 (56 twin / 14 known-gate / 10 modality all rope)
Rejected FAILs10 (8 monadic_reward +1 batchnorm_ema +1 transformer_ssm_lift)

Numbered findings:

  1. Location: moco subsection / “Claims withdrawn…”. Claim: “The available record does not link each fractional value to its tuple key, so I cannot draw the outcome shape across moco’s dimensions.” Evidence: COMPLETE_DIFFICULTY_MATRIX_CSV supplies full difficulty_tuple JSON keys for all 15 moco rows (e.g. distractors/naming/queue_math/… mapped to 1/6, 1/3, 2/5, 2/3, 3/4, 5/6 etc.). Compact Table D omits the strings; complete matrix does not. Verdict: incorrect (keys exist). Severity: correction. Action: Replace with statement that keys are present in the complete matrix and optionally list the nine fractional mappings; do not claim unavailability.

  2. Location: “The environment-by-tuple matrix” (214 rows). Claim: “A total of 214 rows—63% of the matrix—sit in environments where every row has the same outcome.” Evidence: Local check + matrix: 214 only when blanks (unscored) are treated as uniform; supported split is 204 rows in environments with uniform scored outcomes + 10 rows in the two fully unscored environments (epistemic_silence 6 + epistemic_type_games 4). Verdict: imprecise. Severity: correction. Action: Narrow to “204 rows in uniform-scored-outcome environments + 10 in fully unscored environments (or 214 if shared absence of scored outcomes is grouped)”.

  3. Location: “Ten zero-pass environments or seven?” + overview cross-ref. Claim: Correctly uses 7 scored zero-pass and leaves “10” unresolved. Evidence: Table A shows exactly 7 (functorial_augmentation, monadic_reward, sheaf_invariant_gluing, sheaf_physical_constraints, ts_one_step, ts_trajectory, glyph); overview states 10; tuple view yields 19. Unscored-only envs are not zero-pass. Verdict: correct handling. Severity: note. Action: Retain; do not reconcile.

  4. Location: Omission / provenance. Claim: Reports both 14 (exclusion record) and 24 (provenance) known-gate; leaves open; does not present 14+10=24 as verified. Evidence: Table C = 14 known-gate (9 glyph +5 rope) +10 modality +56 twin; provenance prose “24 known gate-blocked”. Verdict: correct. Severity: note. Action: Keep both figures and open status.

  5. Location: Failure labels / dispositions. Claim: Global tallies only; runtime consolidated 9+2; 10 rejected kept in FAIL; archive undefined. Also notes unscored dispositions implicitly via counts. Evidence: Table B + local check: labels sum 128; exactly 10 rejected; 9 scored-FAIL with disposition unscored. Verdict: correct on globals and rejected; slightly incomplete on the 9. Severity: note. Action: Optionally flag the 9 scored/FAIL/unscored disposition cases explicitly as recorded but undefined operationally.

  6. Location: ts_parse_only / ineligible. Claim: Keeps the PASS in 277; flags performance-ineligible and provider-attributed terminal failure vs PASS verdict. Evidence: INELIGIBLE_PASS_CSV_EXCERPT + Table B row 409: verdict PASS, performance_eligible=False, exclusion_reason provider-outage/transient. Verdict: correct; attribution is the recorded field, not independent causation. Severity: note. Action: Retain flag; do not elevate exclusion_reason to proven cause.

  7. Location: Figure 2 caption. Claim: Lollipop of observed pass rates across 36 scored envs; read fraction with case count; not stability. Evidence: Section E describes related interval/lollipop-style env plot (Fig 9) with Wilson intervals and same 36; drafts’ Fig 2 path/units match data but numbering/caption differ from packet’s 8–11. No SVG rendered here. Verdict: substantively aligned, numbering mismatch. Severity: note. Action: Align caption/number to packet or note descriptive match only; do not claim rendered SVG content beyond description.

  8. Location: Seed / dirty / selection / guarantees. Claims: All seed 0, no second seed, dirty source [m-word], 80 omitted, guarantees not interchangeable, no env-by-guarantee cross-tab. Evidence: Table B all seed=0; provenance dirty=true, no clean snapshot; Table C 80; guarantees 189/227 total only. Verdict: correct limits. Severity: note. Action: None beyond retaining.

  9. Location: Public prose / brackets. Claim: Uses [m-word]; no accidental paths, broken MD, or ungrounded authorship. Evidence: Intentional per rules; required fig URLs absent or clean. Verdict: clean. Severity: note.

Blocking-finding count: 0
Correction count: 2 (moco keys; 214 wording)
Note count: 7

2. Draft opus 5
Verdict: accept with corrections

Confirmed-arithmetic table: Identical to the table above (all core denominators, splits, matrix stats, labels, guarantees, omissions, rejected match Tables A–D + local check). Additional verified sensitivities (ex-moco 241/350≈68.86%, ex-glyph 277/381≈72.70%, etc.) are pure arithmetic on existing rows, not new analysis.

Numbered findings:

  1. Location: moco subsection. Claim: “the fractional values are recorded, but no row-by-row key links each value back to its tuple. So I can say that moco is the only environment where outcomes vary within tuples, and I cannot say which tuples those are…” Evidence: COMPLETE_DIFFICULTY_MATRIX_CSV provides the exact keys for every moco row (including the nine fractionals). Verdict: incorrect (keys exist). Severity: correction. Action: Same as gpt #1 — acknowledge complete-matrix keys and map if desired; drop “cannot”.

  2. Location: Matrix section (214 / 63%). Claim: “214 of 340 rows (63%) sit in environments where every row has the same outcome.” Evidence: Same local-check distinction (204 uniform-scored + 10 fully unscored). Verdict: imprecise. Severity: correction. Action: Identical narrowing as gpt #2.

  3. Location: “Ten zero-pass…”. Claim: Uses 7; leaves 10 open; tuple view 19. Evidence: Table A =7; overview =10. Verdict: correct. Severity: note. Action: Retain.

  4. Location: Selection frame / provenance. Claim: 14 vs 24 known-gate both reported, unresolved; 10 modality all rope; does not treat 14+10 as verified reconciliation. Evidence: Table C vs provenance. Verdict: correct. Severity: note. Action: Keep.

  5. Location: Failure labels. Claim: Globals only; “No environment-by-label breakdown is available here”; runtime casing consolidated without over-reading; 10 rejected kept. Evidence: Packet supplies globals; complete matrix has per-row failure_modes but no pre-aggregated env×label table in compact form. Local check notes 9 scored/FAIL/unscored disposition. Verdict: mostly correct (globals accurate; “no breakdown” is true for compact packet, overstated if complete matrix counts are allowed). Severity: correction (mild). Action: Soften to “no pre-built env-by-label cross-tab in the compact packet; per-row modes exist in matrix for counting if needed”; explicitly note the 9 disposition cases.

  6. Location: ts_parse_only ineligible + guarantees. Claim: Keeps in 277, flags inconsistency; guarantees not interchangeable, no env-by-guarantee. Evidence: Excerpt + totals. Verdict: correct. Severity: note. Action: Retain.

  7. Location: Density/sensitivity arithmetic. Claim: Excluding moco/glyph etc. shifts. Evidence: Direct from Table A (55 moco, 24 glyph). Verdict: supported verification. Severity: note. Action: Keep as arithmetic illustration only.

  8. Location: Figure caption / embed. Claim: Markdown image to ../figures/fig2_environment_outcome_lollipop.svg + caption matching 36 scored envs, fractions + counts. Evidence: Section E Fig-style data match; path is required figure URL (not leakage); no binary render. Verdict: acceptable reference. Severity: note. Action: Confirm path resolves in final; caption OK.

  9. Location: Seed/dirty/selection/confounds / [m-word]. Claims: Accurate limits; intentional bracket. Evidence: Matches provenance/Table B. Verdict: clean. Severity: note.

Blocking-finding count: 0
Correction count: 3 (moco keys; 214; mild env-by-label availability)
Note count: 6

3. Shared unresolved source discrepancies

  • Bounded by supplied records: 14 (Table C) vs 24 (provenance) known-gate omissions — both figures exist; Table C rows detail 9 glyph +5 rope; no row-level support for 24 inside the exclusion CSV. 7 scored zero-pass env (Table A) vs overview “10” — overview list enumerates only the 7; origin of 10 unreconciled here (not the 2 unscored-only, not the 19 tuple envs). 214 uniform rows — resolvable as 204+10 once blanks included (local check). moco keys — available in complete CSV, absent from compact Table D. 9 scored/FAIL/unscored disposition cases + 10 rejected — exact IDs in local JSON/Table B; definitions absent.
  • Cannot be reconciled here: Exact dirty working-tree state or causal effect; clean-source counterfactual; seed-variance (only seed 0); whether overview “10” derives from an earlier filter; any env×label or env×guarantee controlled comparison beyond raw counts that can be tallied from matrix; base rate of apparent non-monotonicity; independent causation behind exclusion_reason text (recorded attribution only). Arithmetic coincidences (e.g. 14+10) are not documented explanations.

4. Handoff for the editorial critic
Exact corrections to carry:

  • Both drafts: Insert that complete difficulty-matrix CSV supplies difficulty_tuple keys for all rows (including moco’s nine fractionals); remove or rewrite any “no key / cannot map / unavailable” claim. Optionally publish the nine mappings as descriptive.
  • Both: Re-word 214/63% to distinguish 204 uniform-scored-outcome rows + 10 fully-unscored-environment rows (or explicitly define inclusion of blank pass_rate).
  • Opus (and optionally gpt): Soften “no environment-by-label breakdown” to reflect that per-row failure_modes exist for aggregation; note the 9 scored/FAIL/disposition=unscored cases alongside the 10 rejected.
  • Retain: 277/405=68.4% as scored pass rate; 7 (not 10) scored zero-pass envs; dual 14/24 known-gate reporting as open; ineligible ts_parse_only PASS kept in numerator with flag; all seed-0 / dirty / selection / guarantee / single-seed limits; no causal or common-scale claims; intentional [m-word].
  • Newly available fields for critic: full tuple keys, per-row failure_modes/judge_guarantees, exact disposition flags (9+10), local-check uniform split, INELIGIBLE exclusion_reason text, matrix-derived env totals.
  • Evidence limits: No new model fits, no causal estimates, no imported campaigns, no SVG pixel claims, no fabrication of missing clean snapshot or second seeds. Overview vs Table A “10 vs 7” and provenance vs Table C “24 vs 14” stay open. Web Search found no public archive contradicting the pinned embedded records.

No prose rewrite, no winner choice, no claim that later stages are complete.
